errors.sentence: She don't like coffee in the morning.
errors.explanation: With he, she and it we use doesn't in the present simple.

errors.sentence: Yesterday we goed to the beach.
errors.explanation: Go is irregular: the past simple is went.

errors.sentence: If I will see him, I will tell him.
errors.explanation: In the if-clause of the first conditional we use the present simple.

errors.sentence: My brother is more taller than me.
errors.explanation: Short adjectives take -er; do not add more.

errors.sentence: I have lived here since five years.
errors.explanation: Use for with a period of time and since with a starting point.

errors.sentence: There are much cats in my street.
errors.explanation: Cats are countable, so we use many.
